title: Mera Abbas margaya Baba
body:
haae baba
haae baba
haae baba
<<DIVIDER>>
baba haae baba
koi chadar Najaf se le ao
mera abbas mar gaya baba
sharam aati hai bint-e-zehra ko
<<DIVIDER>>
meri janib na deikhna baba
aaj karbobala ke maqtal mein, qatl bhai behan hue dono - 2
woh udhar zeen se gira tha idher sir se mere giri rida baba
mujh se amma nah pooch len yeh kahin, tairay hotay yeh kya hua zainab -2
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bhai pay chal gayi hai churee mujh pay khanjar nahi chala baba
haye aisa lagta hai us ke jaaney se, aik deewar hatt gayi jaisay - 2
loot lo ab Hussain ke khaimay shaam walon mein shor tha baba
haye mout zainab ko kyun nahi aayi, mar gaye aaj mere sab bhai - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
le chalo mujko bhi waha jaldi, hai jaha mera bawafa baba
haye baat ko mujko yahi rulaati hai, uske baccho se sharm aati hai - 2
Kuch na kar paayi aapki beti, khune abbas beh gaya baba
Haye laash akbar ki jab uthayi thi, sar pe mere rida salamat thi - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye laashe ghazi uthau mai kaise, mere sar per nahi rida baba
Haaaayeeeee
Qatl ke baad phir se qatl hua, neher per bawafa tadapne laga - 2
Haaye meri chadar utha ke nayze per shimr saahil pe le gaya baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri bacchi ye mujse kehti hai, mai bhi ghazi pe jaan dedungi - 2
Haye mar na jaaye ye shaam ke pehle, do sakina ko hausla baba
Aye takallum wo keh rahi hogi, Zaayero per lagi hai pabandi - 2
Meri maa intezar karti hai, Kaun aayega karbala baba
